propositions: REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE environment variable must point to a TOML file whose keys layer over discovered config on a per-key basis rather than replacing the entire config
Configuration precedence order must be: CLI -c > REBAR_LLM_<KEY> env > REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE > discovered config file > default
The deep merge must apply to nested tables (leaf key wins) while arrays replace wholly and are never appended
REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE must be read as a string literal via os.environ.get("REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE") to satisfy static AST scanning for documentation generation
A pointer to a nonexistent file must raise a typed config error rather than silently falling back
The read_reserved_section helper function shallow-merge behavior must remain unchanged to prevent unintended layering changes in other reserved sections
